segments.source_en: Dear family members, peace be with you all. Hello everyone. I am very happy to continue "Weekly Soul-Opening Hour."

segments.source_en: Last week, we continued to share about body, mind, and spirit environmental protection. Last week, the master shared with us about human conscience, and I recalled a quote by Mencius: "All things are within me; to reflect on oneself and be sincere, great joy is here." Today, just like all things in the universe, we humans are inherently complete. How do we achieve this joy? We must reflect on ourselves and be sincere. Reflecting on oneself and being sincere is natural, genuine, and without pretense, filling the heart with joy and happiness. Today we once again respectfully invite the master to mercifully encourage us. Please give a round of applause.
